body:
# Tool Switch

Never stop mining to search for the right tool again.

Tool Switch automatically selects the best tool from your hotbar when you start breaking a block and seamlessly switches back to your previously selected slot once you're finished.

## Features

* Automatically selects the optimal tool for the block being mined.
* Returns to your original hotbar slot after mining.
* Prevents hotbar flickering during continuous mining.
* Respects manual slot changes and player input.
* Supports pickaxes, axes, shovels, hoes, and shears.
* Intelligent enchantment handling:

  * Prefers Silk Touch over Fortune.
  * Considers Efficiency levels.
  * Chooses tools based on actual mining performance.
* Preserves swords by excluding them from automatic selection.
* Fully client-side and lightweight.

Perfect for builders, miners, and players who want smoother gameplay without changing the vanilla experience.
